label: Elpelet

text.BHSA 1CH 14:4: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ שְׁמֹ֣ות הַיְלוּדִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיוּ־לֹ֖ו בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם שַׁמּ֣וּעַ וְשֹׁובָ֔ב נָתָ֖ן וּשְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
text.KJV 1CH 14:4: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
text.KJV 1CH 14:5: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
text.KJV 1CH 14:6: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

A.name: Eliphelet
A.line: son of David (1CH 3:6) [his OTHER son named Eliphelet]
family: son-of david (David, son of Jesse (RUT 4:17), King of Israel (2SA 5:3))

B.name: Eliphelet
family: son-of david (David, son of Jesse (RUT 4:17), King of Israel (2SA 5:3))

why: וְאֶלְפָּלֶט appears among David’s Jerusalem-born children, after Ibhar and Elishua and before Nogah, identifying the earlier Eliphelet represented by A (1CH 3:6). B is the other Eliphelet, listed later in 2SA 5:16.
